rate_offered.notes: Printed '0.90%' in the offered nominal rate; rate type 'קבועה', linkage 'לא צמוד'; adjusted '0.9031%', common '0.90%'; exit points 'לא קיימת' (stations: no); break 'אין אפשרות שבירה'; renewal 'לא קיים' / 'לא מתחדש'. Account type 304, product 101. Amount tiers merged into this record (each as printed): 1,000-24,999: nominal '0.90%', adjusted '0.9031%', common '0.90%'; 25,000-49,999: nominal '0.90%', adjusted '0.9031%', common '0.90%'; 50,000-99,999: nominal '0.90%', adjusted '0.9031%', common '1.00%'. Read 2026-11-09 from the data the page loads (https://apps.fibi.co.il/bff-depositmanagement/api/v1/bankmassad/depositDetails/46, 'effectiveDate' 2026-11-09, 'prime' 4.75); the 447 row is in the family 'פיקדונות מקובלים'.

tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit: interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08). Copied from the rule base (TXI-03's source, read 2026-10-25), not re-read today.
